main.description: Starts moving the requesting user's hosted repos to their PDS. Each repo enters the migrating state, in which the AppView still accepts its writes. Calling it again resumes an interrupted migration.

spaces.description: The spaces whose repos still need to move.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: SpacesUnsupported
errors.description: The user's PDS does not serve spaces yet.
